identity_rule: An asset is tied to a biological sample only by INSDC BioSample accession. Cultivar or accession names are recorded as reported and are never used to infer that two assets come from the same plant.

searched_sources.query: tax_tree(3914): 64 analyses, all REFERENCE_ALIGNMENT (RNA-seq iRAP), no SEQUENCE_VARIATION
313 assemblies listed; no Vigna angularis entry (Vigna unguiculata only)

search_limitations: journal supplementary data, institutional repositories and non-INSDC plant databases were not searched
an absent SEQUENCE_VARIATION analysis in ENA and an absent EVA species entry mean no truth set was found in those sources, not that none exists anywhere

assets.coordinate_system: defines the coordinate system; 36 sequences, 448,362,642 bp
assets.license: INSDC/NCBI public data; NCBI states no restrictions of its own; no submitter licence stated
assets.reason: the pipeline's reference; every region asset below is derived from or checked against this exact FASTA

assets.coordinate_system: 1-based inclusive start/stop on the RefSeq sequence accessions; converted to BED by the region builder
assets.reason: 32 gaps; every one lies inside an N run of the FASTA (checked by build_region_assets.py), so the annotation and the sequence share coordinates

assets.coordinate_system: positions in the reference FASTA itself
assets.reason: the NCBI genomes README states that repeats identified by WindowMasker are lower-cased in eukaryotic genomic FASTA; 162,429,013 bp (36.2%)
not published in the assembly directory (absent from md5checksums.txt); repeat-family strata are therefore not evaluated and no substitute from another organism is used

assets.platform: reference sequence; self-alignment with the pipeline's pinned BWA-MEM2 image
assets.coordinate_system: BED 0-based half-open on the reference FASTA

checksum.kind: sha256 per BED in region_assets.json and mappability.json

assets.role: region assets: N runs, homopolymer >= 10, 1 kb GC partition, 150 bp self-alignment mappability partition
assets.reason: computed from the exact reference; no human or other-organism mask

assets.coordinate_system: reads (aligned by this benchmark to GCF_016808095.1)

checksum.note: only a leading byte range was downloaded, so the published md5 cannot be checked; the downloaded bytes' sha256 is recorded instead

assets.license: INSDC public data; no submitter licence stated
assets.role: short reads of the same BioSample as the reference, on another platform
assets.reason: the same BioSample accession as the assembly, so identity rests on the accession and not on a cultivar name. Aligning these reads to that assembly measures self-consistency between two platforms' data from one BioSample: it is neither truth nor callset-to-callset cross-platform concordance, because the comparator is the reference consensus sequence, which carries its own errors, and the plant's heterozygosity is unknown

assets.role: long reads of the reference BioSample
assets.reason: not independent of the reference (the assembly is built from this BioSample's PacBio data, whether or not from this exact run), so it cannot be truth; calling it would also need a long-read caller that the pipeline does not pin. 19.8 GB of CLR subreads were not downloaded
proximity-ligation library; its chimeric read pairs and restriction-site bias are not a small-variant calling input

assets.platform: 327 WGS Illumina HiSeq X paired; 357 RAD-Seq Illumina HiSeq 2500 single

checksum.kind: md5 per FASTQ; the 51 analysed WGS FASTQs were md5-verified and sha256-recorded by Issue #45

assets.reason: every BioSample has exactly one run and no BioSample has both WGS and RAD-Seq, so the project contains neither technical replicates nor an identity-confirmed cross-method pair; matching RAD and WGS samples by name was not attempted

sample_identity.experiment_title: Illumina Genome Analyzer II paired end sequencing: Vigna angularis Resequencing

assets.platform: Illumina Genome Analyzer II; WGS libraries of 170 bp to 40 kb nominal insert
assets.role: only multi-library WGS BioSample found for the species
assets.reason: one BioSample holds a 'Resequencing' series of about 50 distinct 500 bp libraries, so it cannot be confirmed to be one plant; the only same-library run pairs are 2-40 kb mate-pair libraries (unsuitable for small-variant calling) or 500 bp libraries whose second run is 3.9-5.0x against 17.9-21.7x, which would measure depth rather than replicate agreement
no BioSample in common with the reference or with any analysed cohort sample, so there is no same-sample short-read callset to compare against

assets.organism: Vigna angularis (one sample alias reports var. nipponensis)
assets.reason: no BioSample in common with the reference or any analysed cohort sample
none found: ENA lists no SEQUENCE_VARIATION analysis for taxon 3914 and EVA lists no Vigna angularis assembly
another organism and assembly; human truth, masks and model performance are not transferred to Vigna angularis
